items.headline: Stocks Fall, Yields Rise on Triple Witching Day
items.summary: U.S. stocks eased as Treasury yields rose after the Bank of Japan increased rates; elevated activity and volatility were expected because of triple witching.

items.headline: The Dow Is Down for a Third Straight Week and the Nasdaq Is Somehow Up
items.summary: The Nasdaq was modestly higher for the week while the Dow headed for a third consecutive weekly decline; technology stocks remained supported despite expectations for further rate increases.

items.headline: Stock Market Midday, Sept. 18: Stocks Slip, Crypto Gains
items.summary: Stocks slipped as markets assessed the possibility of additional rate hikes; AI-safety concerns remained relevant to investors and Nvidia's weekly performance was muted.

items.headline: Stock Market News for Sep. 18, 2026
items.summary: Technology and other growth-sensitive stocks benefited from lower Treasury yields, while Intel and AMD were highlighted in the market coverage.

items.headline: Tech Leads Wall Street to Higher Close as Oil Eases, Treasury Yields Dip
items.summary: Technology stocks led a broad rebound as oil prices and Treasury yields eased; CoreWeave fell after announcing plans to raise capital through stock and convertible-bond offerings.

items.headline: US Stocks Sink as Treasury Yields Post Another Session of Gains
items.summary: U.S. equities sold off as Treasury yields rose, with the 2-year yield reaching 4.75% and the 10-year yield moving back above 5%; triple witching added potential volatility.
